intro: Can you set every shot straight?
description:
A scrambled photo can look simple at first... until every slice is facing the wrong way.

You know the feeling: the picture is almost there, but one little turn can change everything.

In this casual rotation puzzle, each stage starts with a single image split into slices. Rotate the pieces back into the right direction, restore the original picture, and try to clear each stage as fast as you can.

・Look over the divided image
・Rotate each slice into the correct direction
・Complete the picture
・Aim for a faster clear time and more stars

There are no complicated rules, so it is easy to jump in for a quick round. But once the slices increase, reading the whole image becomes a satisfying visual challenge.

Take your time, or chase the best result. Can you bring every shot back into place?

Button and touch controls are supported.
